# thegoodplace

> thegoodplace.com 是居家裝飾印刷海報選物店：無酸美術紙、A4／A3／A2 尺寸，繁體中文介面。一張對的海報，能讓客廳與臥室立刻有焦點。

Agents：先讀本檔，再依需求開啟 Markdown 頁面或 OKF 知識包。公開知識允許擷取；購物車頁不索引。

Canonical site: https://thegoodplace.com/

## Discovery standards

- OKF bundle: https://thegoodplace.com/okf/index.md
  (Google Cloud Open Knowledge Format — https://cloud.google.com/blog/products/data-analytics/how-the-open-knowledge-format-can-improve-data-sharing)
- ARD AI Catalog: https://thegoodplace.com/.well-known/ai-catalog.json
  (Google Agentic Resource Discovery — https://developers.googleblog.com/announcing-the-agentic-resource-discovery-specification/)
- ARD manifest: https://thegoodplace.com/.well-known/ard.json
- Preferred Sources (readers): https://www.google.com/preferences/source?q=https://thegoodplace.com/
  (Google original / quality content — https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/products/search/original-high-quality-content-search/)
- Preferred Sources deeplink pattern example: https://www.google.com/preferences/source?q=https://www.prudential.com.hk/
- Sitemap: https://thegoodplace.com/sitemap.xml

## Pages

- [首頁](https://thegoodplace.com/index.html.md): 品牌定位與本季精選海報
- [全部海報](https://thegoodplace.com/shop.html.md): 商品目錄、風格分類與價格
- [商品詳情](https://thegoodplace.com/product.html.md): 尺寸、材質與加購說明
- [關於我們](https://thegoodplace.com/about.html.md): 品牌故事與聯絡方式
- [部落格](https://thegoodplace.com/blog/index.html.md): 原創掛畫與尺寸選購指南
